meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Store a dag definition once and re-run it in one or two lines, instead of pasting the full definition JSON into every eval cell. MUST USE whenever the user wants to save a DAG for reuse, run a previously saved/named DAG, schedule the same graph repeatedly (nightly/weekly audits, recurring multi-agent pipelines), or asks where to put a dag definition file. Triggers: dag library, save this dag, reuse a dag, run the saved dag, stored dag definition, recurring dag, nightly dag, dag 정의 저장, 저장된 dag 실행, dag 반복 실행, DAG 만들어두고 여러 번.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存常用流程一次，以后按名一键重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有反复要跑的流程，想存一次就能复用。
copy.tagline_en: Save a workflow once, then rerun it anytime by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have workflows you run repeatedly and want to store them once.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能把反复使用的 DAG 图存成命名文件,之后用一两行指令即可重新运行同一张图。每次运行时默认自动加时间戳作为新密钥,确保得到一次全新运行,而不是复用旧结果。
howto.when: 当你想保存 DAG 以便复用、运行之前存过的 DAG、或反复调度同一张图(如每日/每周审计)时触发。提到“dag library”“save this dag”等关键词也会触发。

say.text: 把这个图存成 dag,名字叫 nightly-audit
say.note: 会写入 dag 库并用新密钥试跑一次确认可用。

say.text: 运行之前存的 nightly-audit 这个 dag
say.note: 默认加时间戳,当作一次全新运行执行。

say.text: 每晚自动重跑这个审计 dag,别复用上次结果
say.note: 同一 base key 每次加载都会生成新密钥。

howto.what_en: Claude can store a reusable DAG definition as a named file, then re-run that graph in one or two lines. Each run defaults to a fresh timestamp-suffixed key, so it always starts a new run instead of reusing the old result.
howto.when_en: Triggers when saving a DAG for reuse, running a saved/named DAG, or scheduling repeated runs (nightly audits, recurring pipelines). Keywords like 'save this dag' also trigger.

say_en.text: Save this graph as a dag named nightly-audit.
say_en.note: Writes it to the dag library and test-runs it once.

say_en.text: Run the nightly-audit dag I saved earlier.
say_en.note: Runs it as a fresh run with a timestamp suffix.

say_en.text: Re-run this audit dag every night, never reuse the old result.
say_en.note: Each load rotates the key for a new run.
